**Byline:** 宋 元粹述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0257

## Contributors
- 元粹 (A000132)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 2-fascicle anthological commentary on the *Yuánjué jīng* ([KR6i0551](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0551)) compiled by the late-Sòng / early-Yuán Tiāntái master [元粹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%B2%B9) Yuáncuì 元粹 (*hào* Gǔyún 古雲), styled in the work *Tiáoshuǐ shāmén* 苕水沙門. The work is in the standard *jízhù* 集註 ("collected annotations") format: each lemma of the sūtra is followed by a curated selection of glosses drawn from the principal earlier commentaries — chiefly [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's [KR6i0555](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0555) *Dàshū* and [KR6i0553](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0553) *Lüèshū*, but also material from the southern-Sòng *Lèijiě* tradition (see [KR6i0563](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0563)) and Yuáncuì's own brief connecting remarks (*sīzhù* 私註). The result is a compact, classroom-oriented guide to the sūtra suitable for the Tiāntái doctrinal curriculum.

**Abstract**

The autograph preface, preserved at the head of the work (X10 no. 257), is dated 時宋嘉定七年歲在甲戌九月九日 — i.e., the *chóngyáng* (9/9) day of Jiādìng 7 = 22 October 1214 CE (Sòng Níngzōng's reign), and signed *Tiáoshuǐ shāmén Yuáncuì* 苕水沙門元粹. Yuáncuì was a senior dharma-disciple of the Tiāntái master [北峰宗印](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8C%97%E5%B3%B0%E5%AE%97%E5%8D%B0) Běifēng Zōngyìn (1148–1213) and a native of Tiáoxī 苕溪 (Húzhōu); his other major work is the [KR6d0170](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0170) *Sìjiào yí bèishì* 四教儀備釋, a Yuán-period subcommentary on Dìguān's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí*.

The *Jízhù* is the principal Tiāntái-tradition commentary on the *Yuánjué jīng* and forms a counterpart to the Huáyán-tradition exegetical apparatus represented by the [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì corpus. Yuáncuì's reading domesticates the sūtra into the Tiāntái doctrinal framework: the threefold *guān* of the Bodhisattva Mighty-Virtue chapter is read in close alignment with the Tiāntái *zhǐguān* 止觀 doctrine, and the twelve-bodhisattva structure is mapped onto the Tiāntái fourfold-and-fivefold doctrinal classification.
